Overview

Microsoft Azure Services at AtherIQ

If your organisation already runs Microsoft 365, Active Directory and .NET applications, Azure removes a lot of friction. Identity carries across, licensing often works in your favour, and the tooling your developers already use has first-class support.

We build and deploy applications on Azure using managed services wherever they reduce operational load — App Service instead of VMs, Azure SQL instead of a self-managed database server, Functions for event-driven work that does not justify an always-on host.

The emphasis is on outcomes rather than the service list: an application that deploys reliably, scales when it needs to, recovers from failure and costs a predictable amount each month.

Talk it through first

Bring the problem rather than a specification. We will tell you what the work involves, where the risk sits and roughly what it costs before you commit to anything.

What we provide

Included in This Service

The concrete deliverables. Where something is out of scope for your budget, we say so before the quotation rather than after.

Azure App Service

Web application and API hosting with deployment slots, custom domains, managed certificates and staged releases.

Azure SQL & data services

Managed SQL databases with automated backups, geo-replication options, performance tuning and a defined retention policy.

Azure Functions

Event-driven and scheduled processing for integrations, background jobs and webhook handling without a permanently running host.

Azure Kubernetes Service & Container Registry

Container orchestration, private image registries and rolling deployments for workloads that need them.

Storage, networking & security

Blob storage, virtual networks, private endpoints, Key Vault for secrets, and Entra ID integration for application sign-in.

Azure DevOps & pipelines

Repositories, build and release pipelines, environment approvals and infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform.

Business benefits

Why It Matters Commercially

Outcomes rather than a restatement of the feature list.

Identity you already manage

Entra ID integration means staff sign in with existing accounts, and offboarding removes access everywhere at once.

Less infrastructure to run

Managed services handle patching, backups and failover, so your team spends its time on the application instead.

Releases without downtime

Deployment slots and staged pipelines let you validate a release in production infrastructure before it takes traffic.

Costs you can forecast

Reserved capacity, autoscale rules and budget alerts keep the monthly bill inside a range you have agreed.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you provide Microsoft Azure services?

Yes. We design, deploy and support applications on Azure, covering App Service, Azure SQL, Functions, Storage, AKS, networking and Azure DevOps pipelines.

Can you move our on-premises application to Azure?

Yes. We assess the application and its dependencies, choose between rehosting and re-platforming for each component, and run the migration in stages with a tested cutover.

Can you set up CI/CD with Azure DevOps?

Yes. We build pipelines covering source control, automated builds, testing, environment approvals and deployment to App Service or AKS, with infrastructure defined as code.

Do we need to be a Microsoft organisation to use Azure?

No, but the case is strongest if you are. If you already run Microsoft 365, Active Directory or .NET workloads, Azure integrates with them directly. If you do not, AWS may suit you equally well and we will say so.

Ready to scope it?

Send us what you have — a brief, a wireframe, a spreadsheet of the current process, or just a description of what is not working.
